basics.name: Kei Hiroshima
basics.label: PhD Student
basics.summary: I study how machine learning systems can adapt and optimize efficiently in real-world settings, where problems are underspecified and data arrives sequentially in non-stationary streams. My work spans preference-aware model merging for continual learning and LLM-driven formulation and algorithm selection for black-box optimization. I am broadly interested in closing the gap between machine learning and optimization.
